Class QuestGraph

Namespace
ISILab.LBS.Modules
Assembly
LBS.dll
The graph contains the quest nodes and edges, it also contains the grammar reference to validate the graph and the root node reference to easily access it.

Also contains multiple actions and delegates to update the graph and notify the changes to the editor and the following classes:

  • QuestBehaviour: Controls the adding, removal of graph nodes and edges.
  • NodeDataBehaviour: Controls data assignment within a graph node of QuestNode type
  • GrammarAssistant: Controls the validity of the graph's structure and gives fixing recommendations.
  • QuestAssistant: Reads context from other layers (assigned by the user) and recommends new nodes based on the other layer's data.
[Serializable]

IsLooped(GraphNode, GraphNode, HashSet<GraphNode>)

Checks to avoid loops in the graph by traversing it from the destination node to the source node, if it finds the source node again it means there is a loop and the connection should not be added.
